purpose: Make the research-use hypothesis reviewable before authorised exploratory conversations; not a commercial offer or addition to the signed project.

primary_candidate.name: Payroll Decision Evidence Pack
primary_candidate.commercial_unit: One specified research edition with a defined reader-use purpose; any briefing separately scoped and costed before inclusion.
primary_candidate.job: Use grounded payroll decision evidence to decide which investment/change barrier to address and what evidence the next discussion requires.

possible_users.profile: Payroll technology organisations Product, strategy or commercial lead
possible_users.actual_task_example: Decide which payroll buyer problem or investment barrier deserves further product/proposition work.
possible_users.caution: Bounded decision cases and evidence requirements; not market prevalence, product-market fit or a feature roadmap validated by the whole market.

possible_users.profile: Payroll outsourcing organisations Service strategy, proposition or commercial lead
possible_users.actual_task_example: Understand how employers assess a service transition, retained work and implementation readiness when considering outsourcing.
possible_users.caution: Actual scoped buyer accounts, alternatives and constraints, without treating general cases as proof of a particular provider’s delivery.

possible_users.profile: HCM organisations Payroll/HCM product, ecosystem or commercial strategy lead
possible_users.actual_task_example: Understand the organisational and evidence barriers around payroll/HCM change for a defined country and employer context.
possible_users.caution: Decision context and handoff/authority constraints; not product compatibility testing or a system recommendation.

possible_users.profile: Consulting organisations Payroll transformation, operating-model or workforce advisory lead
possible_users.actual_task_example: Support discovery and framing for a defined client decision, or build a reusable internal advisory evidence base.
possible_users.caution: Traceable decision evidence with explicit limits; client-specific recommendations require the consultant’s own work.

possible_users.profile: Investment organisations Research, sector or diligence professional
possible_users.actual_task_example: Identify decision frictions or questions worth examining further in a payroll/HCM business assessment.
possible_users.caution: Exploratory qualitative context only; not valuation, market size, financial forecasts, investment advice or a diligence conclusion.

minimum_useful_output.purpose: The report, summary and actual evidence/method context for the identified decision.
minimum_useful_output.boundary: Uses the research asset JGA is commissioning; no separate bespoke study or new fieldwork promised.

minimum_useful_output.purpose: A short guide to the edition’s relevant sections, actually supported case contrasts and practical templates for the reader’s stated task.
minimum_useful_output.boundary: Interpretation of the same edition only. Show absent/partial evidence explicitly; no invented examples presented as fieldwork or causal recipe.

minimum_useful_output.purpose: Traceable public sources and appropriately cleared aggregate practitioner evidence, with actual dates, scope and limitations.
minimum_useful_output.boundary: No raw identifiable contributions, private documents or unrestricted participant quotations.

minimum_useful_output.purpose: State which edition and intended uses are covered, and identify any circulation or external-use questions needing agreement.
minimum_useful_output.boundary: A planning specification, not an executed licence, a rights grant or a presumption that existing free/public rights are restricted.

optional_components.value_hypothesis: Discuss implications for one stated task and distinguish what the edition can and cannot support.
optional_components.not_included_until: JGA agrees content, audience, preparation, delivery owner, time allowance, follow-up limit, availability and cost.
exclusions: No implementation advice or guaranteed approval
No unlimited follow-up or automatic future edition

primary_candidate.plain_language_concept_after_unaided_dis: We are shaping a practical research pack around payroll investment and change decisions. It would bring together the dated findings, relevant case comparisons and tools for thinking through the evidence and next steps. A short, separately scoped briefing could help your team apply the material to a decision you have described. Which part, if any, would add something to what you already use?
primary_candidate.free_and_paid_overlap_rule: Participating practitioners retain the research free as proposed. Establish actual existing access and intended use first. Do not sell an equivalent second copy to the same beneficiary by default, remove promised access, or assume all team circulation requires another fee. Any paid component must be genuinely additional, wanted, feasible and agreed.
rights_choices_for_agreement: Which edition/version and available materials are supplied
Who is the actual reader/user and whether internal circulation is already covered
Any specifically requested client-facing use, quotation, external publication or commercial reuse
Whether additional interpretation/service is included, and its bounded delivery
How corrections are handled; future editions, updates and renewals are separate decisions
does_not_include: New bespoke interviews or client-specific research
Representative market percentages, validated rankings, a Confidence Index or causal ROI forecast
Technical payroll, tax, legal or implementation advice
Event admission, sponsor access, sales introductions or participant identity/raw answers
Automatic annual access, future updates or unlimited analyst service

delivery_work.owner: JGA/Riseklix roles and actual authorised process to be agreed
delivery_work.cost_driver: Research/coding/checking, writing/design, rights and confidentiality checks; do not treat the current USD1,500 commission as future repeat cost.
Review actual task fit, select supported evidence, prepare reader guide; briefing work only if chosen.
Version manifest, access/usage clarification, delivery, bounded questions/corrections and archive administration.

primary_candidate.version_and_update_boundary: Identify an edition, actual evidence period and delivery version. Correct factual errors through an agreed route; later data, new research, recurring briefings or annual renewal are not silently included. A contract mechanism is not evidence of actual renewal or useful continued use.
reason_to_continue: Buyer identifies a concrete decision and a missing input after actual alternatives are discussed
Evidence scope and cohort limitations are acceptable for that decision
The additional output/service or use permission is clear and deliverable
A relevant decision owner is willing to review a defined scope, without treating that as a sale
disqualifiers: Need is already met by equivalent free/public/internal material or existing contributor access
Only broad interest, no identifiable use or owner
Buyer needs reliable market prevalence, supplier rankings or a guaranteed business result the evidence cannot support
Value depends on private identities, raw answers, favourable findings or unapproved rights
Required country/role/decision evidence is absent and would need unagreed bespoke collection

validation_route.sequence: B01/B02 unaided actual-decision and alternative discussion first; concept only then B03/B04/B05/B06 selectively.
validation_route.capture: Actual use, what is additional, buyer/evidence/rights requirements, constraints, approval route and permitted next step. Hypothetical interest and previous purchasing remain distinct.

assumptions.statement: A dated finished research edition can be useful for a specific decision when its permitted evidence supports that use.
assumptions.decision_needed: Actual buyer use, missing evidence and acceptable limits; not general enthusiasm.

assumptions.statement: An interpretation/briefing or a genuinely additional use permission may add value beyond an equivalent copy of the research.
assumptions.decision_needed: What the buyer already receives, what is additional, who uses it and whether JGA can deliver and clear it.

assumptions.statement: A bounded briefing is a possible future service component rather than technical payroll or open-ended advisory support.
assumptions.decision_needed: Buyer usefulness, named delivery owner, preparation/briefing limits and servicing cost before inclusion.

assumptions.statement: The five buyer categories named in agreement section5 are hypotheses to assess by actual task and intended use; the buyer guide’s product/commercial/strategy focus can be adapted selectively to the person’s role.
assumptions.decision_needed: Actual use, evidence gap, owner, existing alternatives and needed permissions. No category or named firm is a qualified buyer by label.

assumptions.statement: The free practitioner research benefit remains the research promised in Nick’s concept, not a downgraded summary or teaser.
assumptions.decision_needed: Clarify actual additional rights/services without presuming the practitioner’s employer has or lacks any particular right.

signed_project_vs_future_product: The signed project delivers the complete contracted report, feasibility work and materials to JGA. These buyer concepts assess JGA’s possible future products; they do not replace the contracted report with a smaller pack, grant customer rights or add bespoke/service work to Riseklix’s current scope.
contract_basis: Generated working agreement section5 names payroll technology, outsourcing, HCM, consulting and investment organisations as likely-buyer categories to assess. These are feasibility hypotheses, not qualified prospects or an approved launch segment.
